title: Use exactly two long-lived delivery branches
decision: The Engineering Platform uses main as the released branch and develop as the integration branch. Implementation work uses temporary branches from develop and returns to develop before any release promotion.
rationale: Separating released state from integration state provides an explicit promotion boundary while keeping implementation history deterministic and preventing direct feature or hotfix writes to production state.
consequences: main and develop are the only long-lived branches.
Release promotion follows develop to main rather than a direct implementation route.
Released history is synchronized back to develop when required.
